input_transformations.Q1: Byte-identical FEFF input/output subset for mp-1077262, sites 1 and 2, edges L2/L3.
input_transformations.Q2: Projection of saved pre-label dictionaries and ID/reference status; excludes saved labels, retained masks and spectra.
input_transformations.Q3: Q2 projection plus saved stability/theoretical flags.
input_transformations.Q4: Three ordinary aligned spectra projected to CSV; cumulative output withheld. These are released intermediate spectra, not unprocessed measurements.
input_transformations.Q5: Three different ordinary aligned spectra projected to CSV; weighted outputs withheld. These are released intermediate spectra.
input_transformations.Q6: Released base IDs and labels in original row order; excludes all synthetic rows and coverage counts.
input_transformations.Q7: Three byte-identical XAS CSVs. The open release describes literature spectra; do not call these detector-raw measurements.

verification_independence.Q1: Material spectrum copied from released pre-alignment intermediate; no candidate function used. Weights independently inferred from six-site structure header.
verification_independence.Q2: Counts from independently released processed labels; imputation provenance checked against saved dictionaries.
verification_independence.Q3: Flags/counts from independently released retained rows. Figure 1 is contextual, not exact count truth.
verification_independence.Q4: Cumulative arrays copied directly from released processed table, not generated by candidate.
verification_independence.Q5: Numerical reference recomputed previously from released parents and original plotting call; authors embedded plot independently checks shape. No separately released mixture array.
verification_independence.Q6: Prior replay of structurally unchanged author generation methods on the released base table; no independent historical mixture table.
verification_independence.Q7: Peak values independently reduced from raw-release CSVs; qualitative comparison to Figure S1 (smoothed and energy-shifted; qualitative ordering only). No independently published exact peak table.
